verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SDK or client library for building against Buzz. Its programmatic surface is the open Nostr protocol, which third-party Nostr clients speak directly, plus an official CLI, an ACP harness, and an agent runtime. Those are a wire protocol, a CLI, and agent tooling, which are adjacent capabilities rather than official SDKs, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
